patchNotes:
DC: Dark Legion is updating today, May 8! Check out the patch notes below:
Reminder: Dev plans are always subject to change. Watch your in-game announcements for the most accurate information.

  New Content  ,
Hypertime Tracker updates on some servers. Check your in-game patch notes for the info relevant to your Earth.,
Mr. Freeze's Legacy Piece, Nora's Embrace, is now available.,

 New Event: Task Force X (Available on May 10. Requires War Room Lv. 10) ,
A double agent has tampered with the intel folders, planting false clues. Your mission is to find as much real intel as possible without uncovering the fake clues to earn [Intel Assets].,
[Intel Assets] can be exchanged for valuable items in the Exchange Store.,

 New Resource: Black Diamonds ,
Added a new resource, Black Diamonds: Produce them over time in the Heart of Darkness Chamber or earn them from base PvP.,
Added two new rooms, Heart of Darkness Chambers: Unlock at War Room Lv. 8. Produce Black Diamonds over time and can be upgraded.,
Added the Diamond Purification: Exchange Black Diamonds for valuable rewards.,

  Gameplay Updates: Base ,
Added base PvP: Unlocks base attack and defense at War Room Lv. 8, allowing players to scout and attack non-allied players and reinforce league members. Low-level players are protected.,
Added a base Durability system: When a base's defenses are defeated, it loses Durability and catches fire. At zero Durability, the base is relocated and fully restored. Players can put out the fire themselves or request help from league members.,
Added a defense system: Players can activate a shield while under peace status. The shield is removed when scouting or launching an attack.,
Rules: Only Black Diamonds are gained or lost in base PvP battles. Other resources are unaffected.,

 New Gameplay: Black Diamond Infiltration ,
In base PvP, players can infiltrate for other players' Black Diamonds solo or through Coordinated Assaults. Loot is split evenly among Coordinated Assault participants.,
Infiltration Protection: After being infiltrated, players gain a short period of protection, during which they won't lose Black Diamonds again.,
Players can activate a shield to protect their resources from infiltration.,

[Note: Check ⁠💎│black-diamonds-infiltration-g… for details and tips on the new Black Diamond Infiltration gameplay. ]

  Feature Updates: Gift Sending ,
For a limited time, players can send Planet Coins and gifts to others. Once requirements are met, Planet Coins can be sent to friends or sent as gifts in world or league chat.,
Claiming Planet Coin gifts requires an active Super Monthly Pass.,
Bundle sending is now unlocked by reaching a specific VIP level instead of a cumulative purchase threshold.,

 Improvements  ,
After linking your game account to Facebook, you can use your Facebook profile picture as your in-game avatar. You can apply or update it from the Avatar screen. Available on the mobile version only.,
Updated the title for 4th-10th place in Strategic Challenge.,

 Fixes ,
Fixed an issue that could occur when inviting players to a league.,
Fixed various text and display issues.
